newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize lower on plentiful supply.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize lower on plentiful supply.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was lower in good volume trade at midsession Wednesday at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange as plentiful supply washed back into the market, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price for delivery to Bahia Blanca and Quequen fell $3 to $107. Spot soybeans were steady to weaker, also in good volume, on lower nearby Chicago prices. FAS elevator soybeans lost $2 for Rosario delivery to $290. Sunflower seed was dragged lower by soybeans, losing $2 in middling volume to $226 for Rosario. New crop wheat prices lost $4 to $144 as good rain fell throughout crop areas.
